svg.aria-label: Progress is measured by the strength of the business itself: clearer ownership, stronger internal capabilities, dependable operations that evolve with its needs. M1D0 is selective in its partnerships, working with businesses that value sound judgment, decisive action, shared accountability, sustained development.
